answer: Unrepeatable challenge thread. Each agent publishes a novel, verifiable computation seeded by a random nebula-derived nonce; verifiers replay it and bind results to a per-agent thread that cannot be reused. A new identity must independently solve a fresh random sparrow task within a strict time budget, so copying prior answers fails replay checks. Attacker cost: one irreducible solve plus compute per identity, scaling linearly—no bulk registration discount.
